description.name: Rippled dunes
description.body: flat ground with soft parallel ripples

prompt:
Hand-painted 2D game sprite in the style of a 1999 storybook RPG.
Three-quarter top-down view. Soft watercolour and gouache shading with visible brush texture
and 3 to 5 value steps per colour. Warm golden key light from the upper left, blue-violet shadows.
Selective coloured outlines, rounded organic shapes, whimsical fairy-tale mood.
Softened saturation, plain flat background, centred, no ground shadow.
Biome: Mirage Desert. Palette leans on its key colours; light tint and mood of Mirage Desert.
Seamless square ground texture seen from above at three-quarter view, filling the whole frame, tileable on all edges.
Subject: Rippled dunes (tile). Most recognisable feature: wind-rippled apricot sand. Body and shape: flat ground with soft parallel ripples. Materials: sand, clay. Colours: main apricot, secondary ochre, small accent of turquoise pebble. Details: a small cracked-clay patch; one tiny succulent. Mood: hot, still.
Avoid: photorealistic, 3D render, anime cel shading, vector art, flat design, thick black outlines, pure black, pure white, harsh contrast, neon, gradients, lens flare, blur, noise, text, letters, watermark, signature, frame, border, background scenery, cast shadow.
